name: showreel-c3-text-on-photo

voice.text: Nobody can read this poster. The photo is too busy. Turns out, text needs calm. Fix one: darken the photo. Fix two: a solid band. Fix three: one bold colour. Now it reads across the street.

caption:
Nobody can read this poster. Three fixes, same photo. 🎤

1. Darken the photo. A dark layer over a busy picture gives the words calm behind them.
2. Put the words on a solid band. A flat colour behind text is easier to read than any photo.
3. One bold colour for the text. Thin, pale letters disappear into bright light; bold ones hold.

Save this for your next poster, flyer or story. Which fix would you try first?
keywords: how to make text readable on photos
